parameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE independent full-body idle game sprite of character 08, the alchemy prodigy boy, facing SOUTH directly toward the viewer. Image 1 is the exact identity and costume reference; image 2 is the required painted material/style reference only, do not draw its UI. Preserve the round child face, large amber eyes, chestnut brown straight locks and high topknot with jade-gold clasp and two gold ribbons, orange-gold brocade outer coat, ivory wide cuffs and trousers, teal-and-gold front panels, yin-yang belt buckle, jade-green gold-trimmed boots with ivory toecaps. His anatomical RIGHT hand holds the bronze/jade small yin-yang alchemy censer upright on his palm, LEFT hand holds the teal potion vial; the strapped medicine backpack has two ivory scroll tubes, herbs, a brown yin-yang pouch and red/gold tassel. Keep the original 2.5-head-tall short-limbed proportions and the same gear, with physically correct occlusion. Bright clean rounded high-detail hand-painted Chinese Daoist chibi rendering with warm gold and jade materials, preserve orange clothing identity, no plastic 3D look. Camera fixed slight top-down 2D RPG view, full front SOUTH, head and body and toes all face the same direction. Relaxed balanced standing pose, both boot soles on the ground, feet shoulder width, no walking pose, no floating. Native canvas 1024x1024 or larger square; one complete character occupying about 84 percent canvas height with generous clear margin around topknot, ribbons, censer and backpack. Center body axis x=50 percent, lowest sole y=92 percent. True transparent alpha background, NO checkerboard painted into image, no floor, no shadow, no text, no border, no effects, no extra characters. Clean natural antialiased edges, remove the old magenta fringe from the reference. This is an independently newly drawn standing asset, not a crop or copy of the reference. Return just this one full sprite, not a sprite sheet.
